about.heading: 👋 About
about.text: I am a software engineer at Arteris working on Network-on-Chip (NoC) IP for modern SoC design. My background spans electrical engineering, physical design automation, and data science — from ML-based cell layout delay ranking at MediaTek to NoC topology optimization in France. I completed a dual master's path: an M.S. in EE (EDA) at NYCU and an M.S. in Data Science & Network Intelligence at Télécom SudParis. When I'm not coding, I write about life in France on my blog InSeine Adventure.
